How to Run Payroll in Canada: A 10-Step Guide
Run Canadian payroll with a clear process from employee setup and gross pay to deductions, payday, CRA remittances and payroll records. This step-by-step guide shows small business owners what to do, what to check and where payroll mistakes tend to start.
Canadian Payroll Year-End Checklist for Small Businesses
This guide walks through 14 tasks, from payroll reconciliation and remittances to year-end forms and new-year setup, so you know what to complete and when.
How to build a small business budget for the new year
Learn how to build a small business budget from last year’s results, monthly revenue and expenses, cash timing and the business decisions behind each number. This guide covers scenario planning, budget vs. actual reviews and a practical template for keeping the plan useful throughout the year.
How Payroll Software Saves Time for Canadian Small Businesses
Payroll software saves Canadian small businesses time by cutting repeat work across payroll calculations, payments, records and tax tasks. Here's what to automate, what still needs review and what to look for in a payroll platform
2026 Year-End Tax Planning for Small Businesses
Plan your 2026 year-end taxes with a clear review of books, cash flow, assets, payroll and deadlines. See what to handle now, what to confirm with your accountant and what to prepare for filing.
Small Business Accounts Payable: How to Manage Bills and Payments
Learn how to manage accounts payable with a process for tracking vendor bills, scheduling payments and keeping cash commitments visible. Use simple workflows, reports and payment routines to prevent duplicate or late payments and stay on top of what your business owes.

Frequently Asked Questions
Expand all Collapse all
Is Wave's software something I need to install?
Wave's tools are web-based, so you just need an Internet connection and browser—no installation is necessary for our online software!
‍
If you're looking for an on-the-go solution, you can install our mobile app to help you manage invoices and payments. Download our mobile app on iOS and Android today!
What if I just want to try Wave to see if it works for my business?
Sign up for the Starter Plan to take the bookkeeping and invoicing basics for a spin. Then, whenever you’re ready, upgrade to the Pro Plan to unlock even more money management features. Our plans are built for small business owners at every stage!
Can I change plans easily?
You bet! To upgrade to the Pro Plan , sign into Wave. Visit your dashboard or use your invoicing or accounting features, and click the “Upgrade now” button. Learn more about changing subscription periods and plan types in our Help Center.
Is my data secure when I use Wave?
Our servers are protected physically and electronically. Any connections between you, your bank accounts, and Wave are protected by 256-bit SSL encryption. Wave is a PCI-DSS Level 1 Service Provider.
Do you provide customer support?
We provide different levels of support, depending on the plan and/or the add-on features you choose. Learn more about how Wave support works here .
Is it easy to cancel for any reason after I subscribe?
Yes, you can unsubscribe at any time! The cancellation of your subscription will take effect at the end of the billing period in which you cancel. Learn how to cancel your subscription in our Help Center.

Frequently Asked Questions

What if I just want to try Wave to see if it works for my business?
Sign up for the Starter Plan to take the bookkeeping and invoicing basics for a spin. Then, whenever you’re ready, upgrade to the Pro Plan to unlock even more money management features. Our plans are built for small business owners at every stage!
Do I automatically qualify for online payments if I sign up for Pro?
Approval to use online payments is subject to eligibility criteria, including identity verification and credit review. You’ll need to answer a few questions about your business and provide us with a little more information about yourself in order to get approved to accept online payments.
Is it easy to cancel for any reason after I subscribe?
Yes, you can unsubscribe at any time! The cancellation of your subscription will take effect at the end of the billing period in which you cancel. Learn how to cancel your subscription in our Help Center .
Can I change plans easily?
You bet! To upgrade to the Pro Plan, sign into Wave. Visit your dashboard or use your invoicing or accounting features, and click the peach “Upgrade now” button. Learn more about changing subscription periods and plan types, and how to cancel your Pro subscription in our Help Centre.
Is the subscription fee for the Pro Plan per owner or per business?
The subscription fee for the Pro Plan is per business, not per owner. A single Wave account can be used to manage multiple business profiles within it, and if you have e.g. three businesses under one account and want them all on the Pro Plan, you’d sign each business up and subscribe to and pay $19 USD/$25 CAD (plus applicable taxes) three times.
† Savings up to $3,800 USD are based on a 2-year Bookkeeping plan for businesses with 1,000+ monthly transactions, compared to month-to-month pricing. Your savings depend on your business size and transaction volume. On multi-year plans, billed annually. 25% off applies to multi-year plans. Annual plans are 20% off. See Terms and Conditions .
**While subscribed to Wave’s Pro Plan, get 2.9% + $0 (Visa, Mastercard, Discover) and 3.4% + $0 (Amex) per transaction for the first ten cumulative transactions in a monthly subscription period, then 2.9% + $0.60 (Visa, Mastercard, Discover) and 3.4% + $0.60 (Amex) per transaction thereafter. Discover processing is only available to US customers. See our Payments Terms of Service for more details.
***We use Plaid to facilitate bank connections. Not all financial institutions are supported so we can’t guarantee that you will be able to connect an account. Check Plaid's troubleshooting guide for more information .

Frequently Asked Questions
Expand all Collapse all
Does Wave integrate with third-party apps like Shopify, Stripe, and PayPal?
Yes. Wave Accounting integrates with Shopify, Stripe, and PayPal through Make.com, available on the Wave Pro plan. Wave also connects directly with 14 apps, including Etsy, Amazon, GoHighLevel, and Google Sheets. Connected apps sync sales, calculate seller fees, and reconcile transactions into Wave.
What is the difference between Starter Plan and Pro Plan app integrations?
The Wave Starter plan includes core app integration like Google Sheets. The Wave Pro plan adds 13 more, including Amazon, Etsy, MinuteDock, GoHighLevel, and Make.com. Make.com connects Wave to 1,000+ other apps.
How do app integrations reduce manual data entry in Wave Accounting?
App integrations reduce manual data entry in Wave Accounting by importing sales payouts, merchant fees, logged project hours, and customer details directly into the Wave ledger. Fewer manual journal entries mean fewer calculation errors and books ready for your accountant.
Can I build custom integrations if my software isn't listed in the app directory?
Yes. If an app isn't in the Wave integrations directory, connect it through Make.com, which links Wave to 1,000+ apps. Or build a custom integration with the Wave public API.
How do I get started connecting my e-commerce shop or CRM to Wave Pro?
Connect an e-commerce shop or CRM to Wave Pro from the integrations directory in your Wave account. Choose the app, such as Etsy, Amazon, or GoHighLevel, and sign in to authorize it. Wave then syncs transactions, sales fees, and invoice drafts from that app.
